title: Weekly email digest notification preference
purpose: Document the requested member-facing control for switching weekly email digests on or off in notification settings, and the related persistence, account-security message and new-member default behaviors stated in the selected source.

scope.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: As a member, I want to switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member is in notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests on, then weekly email digests are shown as on for that member.
Given a member is in notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests off, then weekly email digests are shown as off for that member.

stories.text: As a member, I want my weekly email digest setting to be the same after I sign out and sign in again.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has weekly email digests switched on, when the member signs out and signs in, then weekly email digests are still shown as on.
Given a member has weekly email digests switched off, when the member signs out and signs in, then weekly email digests are still shown as off.

stories.text: As a member, I want account-security messages to still be sent when I have weekly email digests switched off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has switched weekly email digests off, when an account-security message is triggered for that member, then the account-security message is not disabled by the digest setting.

stories.text: As a newly created member, I want weekly email digests to start switched off until I change the setting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a newly created member, when that member views the weekly email digests setting, then weekly email digests are off.

edge_cases.text: What happens if a member changes the weekly email digest setting and then signs out before the change is stored is not specified in the selected source.
Whether account-security messages are delivered through the same email channel as weekly email digests is not specified.

dependencies.text: Owner and delivery date are unknown.

risks.text: If account-security messages are treated as part of the weekly digest switch, satisfying the digest-off behavior could leave the account-security message request unmet.
If the new-member default is not applied at member creation, satisfying the off-by-default statement could fail for members created before the setting is read.

success_metrics.text: Verification may observe that after a member signs out and signs in, the weekly email digest setting matches the state the member selected before signing out.
Verification may observe that a newly created member's weekly email digest setting reads off without any member action.

open_questions: What counts as an account-security message for the purposes of this setting?
Which channel or channels are used to deliver account-security messages?
What should happen if a member changes the digest setting and signs out before the change is stored?
